description: svc workflow hooks — opt-in guards for execution discipline. PreToolUse hooks are soft warnings or hard gates. Profile control: SVC_HOOK_PROFILE=minimal|full (default: full). Selective disable: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=<comma-separated-ids>. The optional Stop completion guard may hard-block stop when an active task graph still has actionable work.

PreToolUse.description: WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01: ONE deny-capable pre-tool decision engine per host event. Classifies observation vs mutation once against the immutable original input (typed envelope; reason codes OBSERVATION_PROVEN, AUTH_BINDING_MISSING_SELF_HEAL_INELIGIBLE, BRANCH_REF_INVALID, WORKTREE_ROOT_UNAPPROVED), normalizes Git optional-lock reads via per-argv --no-optional-locks (never an export prefix), performs exact existing-worktree self-heal behind fresh positive prompt intent, renews due controller leases as part of authorization, and writes the one-time post-tool correlation receipt. Runs every policy guard (worktree isolation, workflow/bash guard, loop guard, skill-artifact authenticity, session-contract freshness, inertia check, skill-load enforcer, impact triad) as children on the governed path only.

CONSOLIDATED into svc-pretool-decision-engine (WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01): runs as an engine child on the governed path only. HARD BLOCK (full profile): Blocks Write/Edit to linter, formatter, type-checker, test runner configs, and lock files — agent must fix the code, not the config. HARD BLOCK: dynamic phase gate (prerequisite skills incomplete). SOFT WARNING: out-of-scope writes + planning-file edits during execution. WI-399 A1: the former svc-phase-boundary-detector entry is merged into this single spawn (one process per Edit/Write instead of two; --phase-boundary stays valid for old wirings). Disable config-protection only: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-config-protection.

CONSOLIDATED into svc-pretool-decision-engine (WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01): runs as an engine child on the governed path only. HARD BLOCK (all profiles): blocks --no-verify / --no-gpg-sign git bypass. HARD BLOCK (full profile): blocks git commit missing Co-Authored-By trailer. SOFT WARN (full profile): warns on vague commit messages. Disable individually: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-block-no-verify or svc-commit-quality.

Blocks TaskUpdate(completed) when the active task's eval_matrix still has unfilled pillar entries. Structural mode (default): enforces prefix format + evidence refs. AI mode (SVC_EVAL_MODE=ai): also runs a claude -p quality check to verify evidence is substantive, not generic. Scoped to TaskUpdate only — no overhead on other tools.

HARD BLOCK for declared contracts (WI-185): PreToolUse hook for Skill invocations. If a co-located .svc/preflight-<skill>.json config exists, runs preflight checks (inputs readable, outputs writable) and blocks declared failures. Missing contracts still fail open. WI-399 A1: matcher narrowed * -> Skill — the hook is a guaranteed no-op for every other tool (its own logic exits 0 unless tool_name==Skill), so the universal matcher was a pure spawn tax on every tool call.

HARD BLOCK (WI-552 AC-552-4): PreToolUse hook for Skill invocations. If the current session id is the exact session a restart-boundary continuation baton (.svc/continuation/<WI>.ledger.jsonl) launched and is still open, denies diagnose-bug/plan-changeset/execute-changeset (or whatever the baton declares) mechanically. Sessions with no active continuation baton are unaffected. Disable: SVC_DISABLED_HOOKS=svc-continuation-phase-guard.

CONSOLIDATED into svc-pretool-decision-engine (WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01): runs as an engine child on the governed path only. HARD BLOCK (G-4 / WI-114): blocks Edit/Write to canonical skill-output paths (docs/specs/features/, design-tech/, plans/, decisions/, capability-plan.md, etc.) when no recent invocation of the responsible skill exists in .svc/pipeline-decisions.jsonl. Recency window: SVC_SKILL_RECEIPT_WINDOW_MIN (default 90 min). Bypass: SVC_SKILL_ARTIFACT_ALLOW=1.

CONSOLIDATED into svc-pretool-decision-engine (WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01): runs as an engine child on the governed path only. HARD BLOCK: blocks direct file tools and concrete Bash mutation targets when the session contract (.svc/session-contract.jsonl) is stale or mismatched. Read-only Bash remains on the fast path.

CONSOLIDATED into svc-pretool-decision-engine (WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01): runs as an engine child on the governed path only. HARD BLOCK: blocks Edit/Write content that adds APIs or framework patterns listed in references/deprecated-foundations.json unless SVC_INERTIA_ACK records an explicit migrate-vs-extend decision.

WI-361 context diet: injects subject-matter rules BEFORE the first Edit/Write to a signal-matching path (additionalContext + allow; 10K cap; per-session memo). Signal sets live in skills-manifest.json rulesRegistry.
WI-361: command-keyword rule injection (git/gh/docker subject classes) on Bash calls.

WI-384: action-time learning injection — injects the 1-3 learnings keyed (by their files[] arrays + Bash-error-class) to the path/command about to be touched (additionalContext + allow; never blocks; per-session memo; fires → .svc/learning-fires.jsonl).

WI-392: action-time intended-owner routing — when a command/path belongs to a task-class with a registered owner (deploy→base44-environment, browser-verify→Playwright browse mode, per-project app owners via .svc/task-owners.json), injects "route through the owner" (additionalContext + allow; never blocks; per-session memo). Registry: skills-manifest.json ownersRegistry.

PostToolUse.description: WI-FW-HOOKS-SAFETY-01: replay-safe post-tool correlation. A successful call may heartbeat only by consuming the one-time mode-0600 pre-tool receipt bound to host/session/tool-use/original-digest/lease/generation; threshold-renews that exact authorized tuple and mirrors the v1 claim only after v2 success. Replays and mismatches are typed no-ops; failed calls extend nothing. Never grants authority.

Injects eval matrix reminder after TaskUpdate(in_progress). For diagnose-bug tasks: auto-initializes the 8-pillar matrix in lane-tasks.json if not already present, then prints the checklist so the agent sees exactly which pillars need assessment. Scoped to TaskUpdate only — zero overhead on other tools.
Records edited source file paths for batch format+typecheck at Stop time. Full profile only. Appends to .claude/svc-edited-files.json. Never blocks.
Automatically triggers visual verification after UI edits (Edit|Write to .tsx/.jsx/.vue/.css) to ensure Masterclass soul parity. Non-blocking.

HARD BLOCK: validates .svc/lane-tasks-*.json after any Edit|Write. Catches JSON syntax errors and task-graph schema violations immediately at write time. Enforces framework gap G3 from 2026-04-19 Gemini slim-refactor audit. Silent when the edited file is not a lane-tasks JSON.

HARD BLOCK: when a WI file (docs/specs/work-items/WI-*.md) is marked Status: VERIFIED via Edit|Write, verifies the Pillar Revisit Audit table contains all 8 pillars. Draft/in-progress WIs exit 0; malformed VERIFIED WIs block.
OBSERVE: detects high-signal learning candidates after edits and appends only to gitignored .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl. Never writes tracked learning files and never blocks.

Knowledge Spine: incrementally rebuild .svc/spec-index.json when an Edit/Write touches docs/specs/*.md. Best-effort, never blocks. Implements WI-SPINE-001 deliverable 3 from proposals/done/2026-04-30-infra-project-support.md §3.2.
WI-361: earlier-arrival rule injection while exploring (Read/Grep/Glob).
WI-363: auto-records phase receipts when a successful Edit/Write touches a declared phase writes-path (one phase/event; judgment phases manual).
WI-363: auto-records phase receipts on mutating Bash (>>, tee, sed -i, canonical appenders) touching declared writes-paths.

SessionStart.description: Session start: if the opening prompt names a WI/project, inject origin-orchestrator bind context. Never blocks.

SOFT WARN: on session start, resolves the active host via provision/hosts/<host>.json, scans that host's skills path for dangling symlinks and hook command paths, then self-heals with ./setup --host <host> when possible. Never blocks.

SessionEnd.description: OBSERVE: appends a session record (ts + branch) to .svc/sessions/sessions.jsonl for audit-session-execution. Never blocks.

UserPromptSubmit.description: When the prompt names a WI or project, bind origin orchestrator to that linked worktree and inject dispatch context. User never runs a CLI. Never blocks.
SOFT WARN: per-prompt scan of .svc/orchestrator-state.json for active WIs without a matching lane-tasks file. Never blocks.

PreCompact.description: OBSERVE: writes a snapshot of {ts, branch, lane_tasks_files, last_decisions} to .svc/sessions/<ISO>.snapshot.json before compaction so post-compact recovery is deterministic. Never blocks.
OBSERVE: captures high-signal learning candidates before context compaction into gitignored .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl. Never writes tracked learning files.

Notification.description: OBSERVE: appends notification payloads to .svc/sessions/notifications.jsonl so guard violations and host messages are auditable post-hoc. Never blocks.

Stop.description: Batch format+typecheck all source files edited this session — once per Stop instead of per Edit. Detects stack (TS, Python, Go, Rust) and runs the appropriate checker. Exits non-zero on type errors (hard block). Format-only issues are warnings. Full profile only.
HARD BLOCK: scans the latest assistant closeout text on Stop and blocks AP-31 verification delegation or WI-199 V0 bundle-grep substitution when no nearby V1/V2/V3 runtime evidence anchor exists.

Optional completion guard. Blocks stop when active .svc/lane-tasks-<WI>.json task graphs still have actionable work (`pending` or `in_progress`). `blocked` tasks are reported but do not deadlock the stop path. The singular .svc/lane-tasks.json path is legacy compatibility only. Host Stop JSON must be passed through stdin. Requires Bash + Node. Corrupt task state fails closed unless `SVC_COMPLETION_FAIL_OPEN=true` is set.
OBSERVE: captures high-signal learning candidates at session stop into gitignored .svc/auto-learnings.jsonl. Default silent; summary mode is opt-in.

SubagentStart.description: OBSERVE (WI-CLN-13 / plan §4.15): appends a subagent_start record (ts, session_id, agent, prompt_chars) to .svc/dispatch-log.jsonl for parallel-dispatch telemetry. Never blocks.

SubagentStop.description: OBSERVE (WI-CLN-13 / plan §4.15): appends a subagent_stop record (ts, session_id, agent, outcome, exit_code) to .svc/dispatch-log.jsonl for parallel-dispatch telemetry. Never blocks.
